title: measurementData
description: Measurement context containing the covered period, time-series granularity, network location and one or more measured quantities.

period.description: Period covered by the measurement data, represented as an ISO 8601 interval or duration expression.

granularity.description: Duration of each measurement interval. PT15M represents a quarter-hour and PT1H represents one hour.

measurements.description: Measured quantities for the specified location, period and granularity.
